name: How does finish carpentry impact kitchen cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: How does finish carpentry impact kitchen cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry plays a significant role in making cabinet installations look integrated and custom. It involves installing trim pieces, crown molding atop upper cabinets, light rails underneath for concealed lighting, and decorative end panels or toe kicks. These elements conceal gaps, provide a built-in appearance, and add visual interest. A skilled finish carpenter ensures all these components align perfectly with your cabinets, transforming off-the-shelf units into a bespoke kitchen design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry adds trim, molding, and decorative elements to cabinets, concealing gaps and creating a custom, integrated look.
